title: El Morro

terrainReference.basis: Native Calle del Morro approach path at southeast esplanade, outside the moat bridge and fort roofs. Full local256m square fixed before geometry; exported raw600m square retained including untouched empty offshore raster blocks.

note: Measured HABS component plans registered to native fort/bridge controls, checked against nine current local originals. Separate battered bastions, stepped batteries/open courts, six true bridge arches, dry moat/counterscarp, wraparound ochre arcade and blue-gray lighthouse. Physical model-owned ground opening exposes architectural voids without modifying independent USGS3DEP source heights; original terrain restores on model hide. Explicit dry approach terrainReference preserves provider-relative vertical datum. Preview bounds are the immediate fort; city/esplanade beyond counterscarp excluded. Exact mouldings, gun/port positions and current heights remain approximate; see hash-bound source qa.json. Default coarse host terrain compatibility is not certified.

groundCutout.basis: Registered HABS immediate fort, masonry courts/batteries, dry moat and counterscarp; ground removed only while model is loaded and visible. Original provider heights remain available for anchoring and restore when model hides. Model-owned architectural floors and battered-wall bases must close all rendered openings.
